title: SEC4: watch_once mutable parameter purpose not documented
description:
Function watch_once (line 232) takes last_message_state: &mut String but:
- The doc comment doesn't explain why it's mutable or what gets updated
- Line 366 mutates it with '*last_message_state = new_state' 
- The caller (cmd_watch) doesn't make the relationship to last_event_id clear
- A maintainer must trace through multiple functions to understand the state tracking design

SUGGESTION: Add doc comment line to watch_once explaining 'On state change, updates last_message_state to the new token' or similar, so the contract is clear at the call site.
